# NootropicStacker

> The free nootropic supplement stack builder. 195 compounds, real-time synergy analysis, Stack Score rating, interaction warnings.

NootropicStacker is a free tool for biohackers and cognitive optimizers to build, analyze, and score nootropic supplement stacks. It covers 195 supplements including racetams, adaptogens, mushrooms, vitamins, and amino acids.

## Core Features
- Stack Builder: Add supplements, get real-time synergy analysis and interaction warnings
- Stack Score: 0-100 rating across synergy, coverage, balance, and efficiency
- Supplement Library: 195 compounds with dosage ranges, effects, mechanisms
- Personalized Quiz: Find your optimal stack based on goals
- Guides: Blog posts and family guides covering nootropic categories

## Key URLs
- https://nootropicstacker.com/ — Stack Builder
- https://nootropicstacker.com/supplements — Full supplement library
- https://nootropicstacker.com/quiz — Personalized stack quiz
- https://nootropicstacker.com/blog — Research and guides
- https://nootropicstacker.com/families — Supplement family guides

## Popular Supplements Covered
Lion's Mane, Bacopa Monnieri, Ashwagandha (KSM-66), L-Theanine, Alpha-GPC, Citicoline, Rhodiola Rosea, Phosphatidylserine, Creatine, Omega-3/DHA, Magnesium Glycinate, Vitamin D3, CoQ10, Piracetam, Aniracetam, Noopept, Modafinil, Caffeine, Cordyceps, Reishi

## Supplement Categories
Nootropics, Adaptogens, Mushrooms, Racetams, Vitamins, Minerals, Amino Acids, Antioxidants, Sleep Support, Performance
